title: Hand sketch of sky-blue canyon object with "20 FT" dimension and side profiles
description: Typed witness account of a sky-blue object seen traveling about 75 feet in the air through a canyon, observed by a father and his sons, with an agent's note on the witnesses' sincerity. Below, a hand-drawn sketch shows a domed, elongated craft with a dimension line marked "20 FT" and wavy marks at one end, plus three small profile views (a flat-topped trapezoid, an oval, and a domed shape).
